name: CMX Holdings Limited
summary: CMX Holdings Limited presently reports no substantial operational endeavors. In its earlier history, the company's activities included leasing arrangements, the provision of inter-corporate deposits and loans, various investment pursuits, bill discounting services, and a spectrum of other financial undertakings. It was formerly recognized as SIEL Financial Services Limited. The firm was established in 1983 and operates from its base in Indore, India.
